title: Stasis Spells & Locked Mercury
description: A nighttime street scene featuring the corner of a magical shop with a large blue door covered in glowing white runes and a wooden hanging sign reading 'STASIS SPELLS & LOCKED MERCURY'. The shop window displays potion bottles, an hourglass, a clock, and various magical symbols. A small wooden step stool sits on the cobblestone street in front.
